title: allow read-only git grep or git show HEAD:PATH for reviewer roles so a revert check on a non-Go prompt file can be shown with tool output

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261126-002357-b81a, project ork, item S597:

allow read-only git grep or git show HEAD:PATH for reviewer roles so a revert check on a non-Go prompt file can be shown with tool output

Evidence: git -C WORKTREE grep -c ... HEAD -- internal/roles/prompts/ui.md was denied (no approval surface); S592 tracks the same need
